# uptimekuma_notification_pushover (Resource)

Pushover notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_pushover" "example" {
  name      = "My Pushover Notification"
  is_active = true
  user_key  = var.pushover_user_key
  app_token = var.pushover_app_token
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: app_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change app_token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_pushover" "write_only" {
  name = "Pushover with a write-only secret"

  user_key = "your-pushover-user-key"

  app_token_wo         = "your-pushover-app-token"
  app_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) Pushover user key

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_token` (String, Sensitive) Pushover application token. Stored in state; use `app_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `app_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Pushover application token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `app_token`; requires `app_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `app_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `app_token` until the next apply with `app_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `app_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `app_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `app_token_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `device` (String) Device name to receive notifications
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `priority` (String) Priority level for notifications
- `sounds` (String) Notification sound
- `sounds_up` (String) Notification sound when monitor is up
- `title` (String) Notification title
- `ttl` (String) Time to live for notifications

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
